scope: S101 field signs for the remaining 16 sites: observation, judgement hint and danger note; reading grants knowledge only, no reward and no task progress
rules: 迹象是观察：只给信息与判定提示，不发奖励、不完成任务、不替代当事人同意
判定提示写“看得出什么”，不写数值与掉落
危险提示给退路，不给解法；不新增道具
与人物、文书互链；同一地点若有人物，迹象只说现场，不替人物说话

signs.title: 倒木上的抓痕
signs.obs: 离地一人高的抓痕，三道并排，树皮向外翻；下方落着碎蜂巢。
signs.judge: 是护崽母熊的领地标记：抓痕越高，熊越大。
signs.danger: 别顺着抓痕方向走；退的时候别跑。
signs.title_en: Claw Marks on a Fallen Trunk
signs.obs_en: Three parallel scores at shoulder height, bark curling outward; a crushed honeycomb below.
signs.judge_en: A sow bear boundary mark: the higher the scores, the bigger the bear.
signs.danger_en: Do not follow the line of the marks; back off without running.

signs.title: 果园篱笆的塌口
signs.obs: 篱笆压塌一段，果核堆在缺口内侧，脚印往返都走同一个口。
signs.judge: 熊把这里当固定觅食路；缺口是新近踩塌的。
signs.danger: 夜里别进园；装死无效，退到开阔处。
signs.title_en: A Breach in the Orchard Fence
signs.obs_en: A fence section pressed flat, pits piled inside the gap, prints entering and leaving by the same hole.
signs.judge_en: The bear uses this as a feeding route; the breach is freshly trampled.
signs.danger_en: Stay out of the orchard at night; playing dead fails, retreat to open ground.

signs.title: 哨位草垫
signs.obs: 壕沟内侧草垫压得很实，旁边插着削尖的木桩，灰烬是新的。
signs.judge: 营里有人换班；草垫朝向说明哨位盯着来路。
signs.danger: 别从正坡上；绊索就挂在草垫前两步。
signs.obs_en: A pad pressed hard inside the ditch, sharpened stakes beside it, ash still fresh.
signs.judge_en: The camp runs shifts; the pad faces the approach, so the sentry watches the path up.
signs.danger_en: Do not come up the main slope; trip cords run two paces before the pad.

signs.title: 火塘三石
signs.obs: 三块石头围成的火塘，灰是冷的；旁边草被压平，像睡过两三夜。
signs.judge: 过路人临时营地，规矩是走前把火压灭。
signs.danger: 冷灰里可能还埋着炭；夜里有人借宿不打招呼。
signs.title_en: Three Stones of a Fire Ring
signs.obs_en: A ring of three stones, ash cold, grass nearby flattened as if slept on for two or three nights.
signs.judge_en: A travellers camp; the rule is to smother the fire before leaving.
signs.danger_en: Cold ash can hide embers; strangers may share the spot without a word.

signs.title: 补过的帐布
signs.obs: 帐布补丁叠补丁，晾绳上还挂着没收走的布条；地钉斜插，扎得很浅。
signs.judge: 流民过夜处：帐子不锁，收帐才走。
signs.danger: 地钉伤脚；帐布受潮，别在里面生火。
signs.obs_en: Patch over patch, a cloth strip still on the line, pegs set shallow and crooked.
signs.judge_en: A shelter for displaced folk: the tent is not locked, it leaves when they do.
signs.danger_en: Pegs catch feet; damp canvas and a fire inside do not mix.

signs.title: 洞口熄过的火
signs.obs: 洞内三步处有熄火堆，药篓残片压在石下；地面苔线被踩断。
signs.judge: 采药人歇脚点；歇脚不进深段。
signs.danger: 浅洞也有野兽借宿；进前先听。
signs.title_en: A Dead Fire at the Cave Mouth
signs.obs_en: Three paces in, a smothered fire, herb-basket shards under a stone, moss line broken by boots.
signs.judge_en: A herbalist rest stop; rest stops do not go deep.
signs.danger_en: Even shallow caves shelter animals; listen before entering.

signs.title: 蹭秃的树皮
signs.obs: 洞口两侧树皮蹭得发亮，地面爪印同向，骨堆在兽道口。
signs.judge: 兽道明显，走的是同一头；骨堆是进食处。
signs.danger: 护崽野兽守在兽道口；退比跑安全。
signs.obs_en: Bark polished on both sides of the mouth, prints heading one way, bones piled at the trail head.
signs.judge_en: A clear animal trail used by one beast; the bone pile is where it feeds.
signs.danger_en: A guarding animal holds the trail head; backing away beats running.

signs.title: 根洞与刻痕
signs.obs: 老梣树根系间有空洞，树皮上刻着旧记号；洞底积水反光。
signs.judge: 记号是早年的路标，指的不是洞，是绕行的方向。
signs.danger: 根洞积水，蛇会借凉；别把手伸进空腔。
signs.obs_en: A hollow between ash roots, old marks cut in the bark, water glinting at the bottom.
signs.judge_en: The marks are an old road sign; they point away from the hollow, not into it.
signs.danger_en: Hollows hold water and snakes; keep hands out of the cavity.

signs.title: 冲沟与漂来的木片
signs.obs: 谷地中央一道新冲沟，沟沿挂着上游漂来的木片与草根。
signs.judge: 雨来得快，水线比人快；冲沟是上一场雨的线。
signs.danger: 暴雨时别下谷；退到高处等水落。
signs.obs_en: A fresh gully down the valley floor, wood chips and roots snagged on its lip.
signs.judge_en: Rain arrives fast; the water line runs quicker than a person; the gully is last storm line.
signs.danger_en: Stay out of the valley in a downpour; wait on high ground until it drops.

signs.title: 窖口结网
signs.obs: 废弃窖口结着灰网，网后散着骨片；窖口窄，只容侧身。
signs.judge: 窖内缺氧，出入只有这一个口。
signs.danger: 别独自侧身进；点火会把氧耗得更快。
signs.obs_en: Grey web over an abandoned cellar mouth, bone fragments behind it; the opening fits one person sideways.
signs.judge_en: Air inside runs thin, and there is only this one way in.
signs.danger_en: Do not squeeze in alone; a flame burns the air faster.

signs.title: 水边蹄印
signs.obs: 水边泥地上蹄印杂乱，深浅不一；树皮被啃到齐腰高。
signs.judge: 清晨是饮水时段，野物成群；蹄印说明这几天来过。
signs.danger: 清晨饮水时最危险；别在下风处蹲守。
signs.obs_en: Mud churned by prints of differing depth; bark gnawed to waist height.
signs.judge_en: Dawn is the drinking hour and the herd comes together; the prints say they came these days.
signs.danger_en: Dawn at the water is the worst hour; do not wait downwind.

signs.title: 晾草架与茬口
signs.obs: 晾草架还立着，茬口整齐；架下散着断绳与两把旧镰。
signs.judge: 收草季人多，械斗与误伤都出在这几天。
signs.danger: 别在收草时穿场；镰比人快。
signs.obs_en: The rack still stands, stubble cut even; snapped cord and two old sickles beneath.
signs.judge_en: The haying season draws crowds; brawls and cuts happen in these days.
signs.danger_en: Do not cross the field while haying; a sickle is quicker than a person.

signs.title: 矿车残件与记号
signs.obs: 矿车残件堆在轨旁，木撑上刻着捡拾人的记号；轨面下沉一段。
signs.judge: 记号标出下沉段；捡拾人只走轨枕。
signs.danger: 木撑朽坏，别靠；轨下沉会崴脚。
signs.obs_en: Cart parts piled by the rails, the salvager marks cut into the props, a stretch of rail sunk.
signs.judge_en: The marks flag the sunken stretch; the salvager walks sleepers only.
signs.danger_en: Rotten props, and sunken rail turns ankles; do not lean on either.

signs.title: 折枝的新茬
signs.obs: 灌木折口是新的，高度到胸口；泥地蹄印比牛蹄还大。
signs.judge: 驼鹿刚过，折枝高度说明体型。
signs.danger: 发情期驼鹿主动冲撞；绕到它上风处。
signs.obs_en: Breaks are fresh, chest-high; prints in the mud larger than an ox hoof.
signs.judge_en: A moose just passed; break height tells the size.
signs.danger_en: In rut a moose charges; circle to its upwind side.

signs.title: 拖痕与界桩
signs.obs: 田界木桩被啃出缺口，草上拖着一条浅痕通向棚圈方向。
signs.judge: 狼群入冬前靠近棚圈；拖痕是叼走猎物的路。
signs.danger: 狼群护食；别追拖痕，护好牲畜先。
signs.title_en: Drag Marks and a Boundary Post
signs.obs_en: A post gnawed at the notch, a shallow drag line running toward the pens.
signs.judge_en: Wolves close in on pens before winter; the drag is how prey is carried off.
signs.danger_en: Wolves guard their kill; do not follow the drag, see to the stock first.

signs.title: 旧猎径上的爪印
signs.obs: 旧猎径上爪印深浅不一，前爪比后爪深；风向标草朝同一侧倒。
signs.judge: 独狼也走这条径；爪印深浅说明它跑过。
signs.danger: 独狼也会扑人；沿倒草的反方向退。
signs.title_en: Prints on an Old Hunting Path
signs.obs_en: Prints of uneven depth on the old path, front deeper than rear; grass laid one way.
signs.judge_en: A lone wolf uses this path too; print depth says it ran.
signs.danger_en: A lone wolf will still charge; retreat against the laid grass.
